env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME KSC, acme_ksc. Each retailer that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_ksc for the prefix ACME KSC

env.name: KSC_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the retailer's iVendNext start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME KSC).
env.purpose: Filled in for you: the prefix your app's names start with, like ACME KSC

env.name: KSC_PAGE_URL
env.about: Where the kitchen's screens reach this service's page (https://kitchen-screen.example.app). Each screen's link points there.
env.purpose: Your service's web address, where the kitchen's screens open their page

env.name: KSC_LIVE_URL
env.about: Optional: where the screens reach the live service beside this one (https://kitchen-screen-live.example.app, live/). Set, the page may reach that one address and listens there; unset, the screens read every 3 seconds only.
env.purpose: Your live service's address, if you run it beside this one: the screens then update at once instead of every 3 seconds
